pkgmetadata.longdescription: The TypeScript compiler, built from source, slotted per exact version: TypeScript 7 (7.x, the compiler written in Go, from tsc/ of the TypeScript repository) and TypeScript 6 (6.x, the JavaScript implementation with its JavaScript API, built the way upstream builds its npm package). Installed in /usr/lib/typescript/VERSION/ with the npm packages' layouts, as /usr/bin/tsc-VERSION. Primarily build dependencies of www-client/chromium, which pins exact versions.
